hypothesis: Deliberate melee farming with draft-cached layout, ability sequencing, completed capture, deterministic reinvestment and timely tribute will increase matched win rate and mean submitted gems over the trusted starter without introducing bot faults.
falsifier: Non-positive matched win change, non-increasing mean submitted gems, or a new own bot fault.

decision.bottleneck: Starter has random draft/stat choice, no spells or deliberate reinvestment, nearest-only farming and unsafe repeated recall.
decision.evidence: Source-grounded foundation deduction; recent rejected experiments evaluate different revisions.
decision.chosen: Independent melee objective farmers with soft exposure cost and bounded shortlisted route scans.
risks: Static shortlist and Chebyshev route ranking can miss a superior reachable camp.
No live shared claims; visible ally penalties can still permit duplicate clears.
Soft exposure model underestimates incoming damage; retreat may interrupt a nearly complete clear.
Draft memory keeps nearest 509 group anchors if a map exceeds capacity.
100x100 and 4/5-pick coverage remains unmeasured by this smoke.
